description.value: The Surf Lodge and Pub is a boutique, rustic restaurant, pub, and lodging establishment on the north end of Gabriola Island, a short ferry ride from Nanaimo. It offers ocean views, a sunset dining room, a fireplace lounge, and an outdoor patio with a pet-friendly lawn facing the Strait of Georgia. Touring cyclists arriving by ferry will find a full-service pub and dining room serving American cuisine with vegetarian and gluten-free options.

address.value: 885 Berry Point Rd, Gabriola, BC V0R 1X1
